answer: One concrete defence is stake-bonded reputation with slow unbonding: each agent locks a deposit before transacting, and reputation accrues only through verified work, like a mesa rising grain by grain. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and wait out the same history, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds plus months of idle capital. Even at the nadir of activity, slashing burns the bond of any identity caught double-signing, while honest agents spread like yarrow — cheap to sustain, expensive to fake at scale.
